explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/976: F_f(n) is the greatest prime divisor of ∏_{m≤n} f(m) for irreducible f ∈ ℤ[x] of degree d ≥ 2.  is maxPrimeFac of |∏_{m∈[1,n]} f(m)|; there are no integer roots, so the product is nonzero. Tenenbaum proved F_f(n) ≫ n·exp((log n)^c) for some c > 0. The statement matches. Faithful.
